# Vendored code

Hooks modules can import only files inside the plugin, so dependencies are vendored here.

| File | Source | Version | License | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `js-yaml.mjs` | `dist/js-yaml.mjs` from the npm package `js-yaml` | 4.1.0 | MIT (`js-yaml.LICENSE`) | `16f210b939b359b6ec8dde581eb62c157185711dc7b719b33779c43db5c31a91` |

`js-yaml.d.mts` declares the subset of the API that cc-okf calls.
